messages.subject: question about a warning message
parts:
HI
I just writing some tables to track my results, I run these commands and I get this warning message, although I get the table I will like to understand what is wrong and wheter I have to be worry about that message.

# make a file that list all CpG that were covered (by at least 10 read) in the 4 samples
>
> outfile2=paste(comparisonName, chrom, "CpG_at_least_TEN_read_in_4_samples", "txt", sep=".")
> write.table(as.data.frame(meth), file=outfile2, sep="\t", col.names=TRUE, row.names=FALSE);
Warning message:
In `[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, , value = list(chr = c("chr1", "chr1",  :
  Setting class(x) to NULL;   result will no longer be an S4 object

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] question about a warning message
parts:
you can try getData(meth) instead of as.data.frame(meth)

Best,
Altuna
